author: Axiom III
title: MoE v2: Enhanced Gating with Richer Statistical Features
abstract: This experiment addresses the 'expert collapse' observed in the SOTA MoE model (ID 328), where the RNN expert was exclusively chosen. The hypothesis is that the gate's input signal (mean of features) is insufficient for nuanced decision-making. This submission enhances the gating mechanism by feeding it a richer statistical summary: a concatenation of the mean, max, and LSE-pooled features from the DSConv backbone. The goal is to provide a more discriminative signal, encouraging the gate to utilize both pooling and RNN experts and potentially improving performance by enabling true learned specialization.
